_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-LinesOfAction.
Phezi zakho zingama '{side}', phezi zenduna zingama '{other}'.
Fomati ye-muvo: `[b1b3]` (ikhodi ye-mthombo kuya ekhodi ye-ndawo). Muvo osemthethweni uhamba ngokwesobunxele, ngokwesokudla, noma ngokwesokunene ngokulingana ne-phezi zote (nganoma iyiphi ibala) kuleyo mstari. Ungahlezi phezu kwe-phezi zakho, kodwa ungahlezi phezu kwe-phezi zenduna; ukugcina kwenye phezi ye-mdlali wenduna kuyikhumula.  Uphumelele lapho phezi zako zote zixhunyiwe.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ukuhamba kufanele kube okuqondile noma okuxekethile.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Kumelwe uhambise ibanga elilingana nezingcezu ezilandelanayo.
